definitions.explanation: The period when the capital was at Heian-kyō, present-day Kyoto, from 794 until the Kamakura shogunate took power in 1185. Court aristocrats, above all the Fujiwara family, held power, and kana writing and court literature flourished.

examples.japanese: {平安時代|へいあんじだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{貴族|きぞく}→貴族：17414_kizoku⟧。
「⟦{源氏物語|げんじものがたり}→源氏物語：31025_genjimonogatari⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{平安時代|へいあんじだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}かれた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The Tale of Genji was written in the Heian period.

examples.japanese: {平安時代|へいあんじだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ひらがな⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まり→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧、⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{文学|ぶんがく}→文学：01505_bungaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{栄|さか}えた→栄える：13104_sakaeru⟧。
examples.english: In the Heian period hiragana spread, and literature by women flourished.

notes:
Named after {平安京|へいあんきょう}, the capital founded in 794 on the site of present-day Kyoto.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平安時代|へいあんじだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{貴族|きぞく}→貴族：17414_kizoku⟧: Heian aristocrats
- {平安時代|へいあんじだい}⟦{中期|ちゅうき}→中期：18820_chuuki⟧ / ⟦{後期|こうき}→後期：12603_kouki⟧: the mid / late Heian period
- {平安文学|へいあんぶんがく}: Heian literature

CULTURAL NOTE:
In school history the period stands for refined court culture: ⟦{紫式部|むらさきしきぶ}→紫式部：30771_murasakishikibu⟧'s ⟦{源氏物語|げんじものがたり}→源氏物語：31025_genjimonogatari⟧, {清少納言|せいしょうなごん}'s ⟦{枕草子|まくらのそうし}→枕草子：31026_makuranosoushi⟧, the growth of kana, and the rule of the Fujiwara regents. It ends with the war between the Taira and Minamoto clans.
